text: Good evening. I have been waiting for callback since and nobody is answering, so I am writing now. My grandson is 21 months. His temperature is 37.9. He is teething, dribbling saliva everywhere, chewing anything he can hold, one cheek is red. His nappy area is red and sore, he cries when I am cleaning it. But he is not drowsy at all o, he is wide awake, chatting and watching cartoon with his eyes open. I just want to know what cream to use for the bum and what to give for the teeth. Please somebody should respond.
